##Load the packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(malariaAtlas)

# Setting light theme as default
theme_set(theme_light())
```

## Inspect the data

```{r}
#PR points for Tanzania, considering both Plasmodium falciparum and Plasmodium vivax
Tz_pr <- malariaAtlas::getPR(country = "Tanzania", species = "BOTH") %>% filter(!is.na(pr))
glimpse(Tz_pr)

```

```{r}
names(Tz_pr)
```

```{r}
head(Tz_pr)
```

```{r}
# number of observations and variables
dim(Tz_pr)
```

```{r}
str(Tz_pr)
```

## Check for missing values

```{r}
# missing values in each variable
Tz_pr %>% summarise(across(everything(),~ sum(is.na(.))))
```

```{r}
# Check missing coordinates
# Check specifically for missing geographic coordinates
Tz_pr %>% summarise(missing_longitude = sum(is.na(longitude)), missing_latitude = sum(is.na(latitude)))
```
 
```{r}
# time periods
Tz_pr %>% summarise(first_year = min(year_start, na.rm = TRUE),last_year = max(year_start, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
#number of observations available for each year

Tz_pr %>% count(year_start) %>% arrange(year_start)
```

```{r}
# sorting observations by the year the study started
Tz_pr %>% arrange(year_start) %>% View()
autoplot(Tz_pr)

```

```{r}
# the distribution of malaria parasite rate 
Tz_pr %>% summarise(minimum_PR = min(pr, na.rm = TRUE),
                    lower_quartile = quantile(pr, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
                    median_PR = median(pr, na.rm = TRUE),
                    mean_PR = mean(pr, na.rm = TRUE),
                    upper_quartile = quantile(pr, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
                    maximum_PR = max(pr, na.rm = TRUE))
```
## Prevalence over time

```{r}
# Malaria prevalence over time for each year
Tz_pr_year <- Tz_pr %>%
  group_by(year_start) %>%
  summarize(examined = sum(examined),
            positive = sum(positive),
            studies = n(), 
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(pr = positive/ examined)
```

```{r}
ggplot(Tz_pr_year, aes(year_start, pr)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format()
  ) +
  labs(title = "Malaria prevalence in Tanzania over time",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Malaria parasite rate"
  )
```
```{r}
# the number of PR observations available for each year.
Tz_pr %>% count(year_start) %>%
  ggplot(aes(year_start, n)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Number of malaria PR observations by year",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of observations"
  )
```
## Geographical distirbuition


```{r}
# For All time prevalence 
Tz_pr_distr <- Tz_pr %>%
  arrange(pr) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(longitude, latitude, color = pr)) + 
  borders("world", regions = "Tanzania") +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "blue", high ="red", midpoint = .5, labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  theme_void() + 
  coord_map()

Tz_pr_distr
```
## Geographical distribuition by decade

```{r}
# Create decade variable
Tz_pr_decade <- Tz_pr %>%
  mutate(decade = floor(year_start / 10) * 10)

# Check the decade categories
table(Tz_pr_decade$decade)
```

```{r}
# decade categories for each PR
Tanzania_map <- getShp(country = "Tanzania")

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = Tanzania_map, fill = NA) +
  geom_point(data = Tz_pr_decade, aes(x = longitude,y = latitude,color = pr)) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "blue",mid = "white",high = "red",midpoint = 0.5,labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  facet_wrap(~decade) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = "Malaria Prevalence in Tanzania",color = "Malaria PR"
  )
```
